props.description: The cluster name for Exadata and 2-node RAC virtual machine DB systems. The cluster name must begin with an alphabetic character, and may contain hyphens (-). Underscores (_) are not permitted. The cluster name can be no longer than 11 characters and is not case sensitive.

props.name: computeModel

Note: For a single-node DB system, this list is empty.
